title: ensemble.yaml
description: The agent team for one project: the agents a calling agent can delegate to, and the LLM backends Ensemble's own agents run on.

llm_backends.description: Model endpoints. The key is the backend's name, which an `ensemble` adapter's `llm_backend` refers to.

agents.description: The team. The key is the agent's name, which the calling agent delegates to. The names are yours.

type.description: How the model is reached. openai-compatible-api: any /chat/completions endpoint (llama-server, vLLM, Ollama, a hosted API).

base_url_env.description: Required. The NAME of the environment variable holding the base URL, e.g. OPENAI_LOCAL_BASE_URL. Not the URL itself.

base_url_default.description: Used when the variable named by base_url_env is unset or empty, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.

api_key_env.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding the API key. Keys are never written in this file.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds one request to this backend may take before it is cut off.

prompt.description: What this agent is for. Its first line is what the calling agent sees when it lists the team; the whole of it is the agent's system prompt. Keep it short for small local models.

context_window.description: Required when the adapter has `tools`. Tokens of context the model really runs with (Ollama: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH, 4096 unless raised). A server that overflows silently drops the oldest messages, so Ensemble trims old tool output to stay within it.

max_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one delegation. At the limit the run stops and returns what it did, marked unfinished. Only for agents whose adapter has `tools`.

adapter.description: What runs this agent. `type` decides which other fields apply.

type.description: ensemble: Ensemble's own agent harness, run on one of `llm_backends`. Other agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex) will be further types.

llm_backend.description: Name of a backend defined under `llm_backends`.

model.description: The model id as the backend names it, e.g. qwen3-coder or qwen3.5:9b.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, overriding the model's own default.

reasoning_effort.description: How much a reasoning model thinks before answering. `none` turns thinking off, which fixes small-context runs where thinking uses the whole reply.

tools.description: Ensemble's own tools this agent may use, inside the project. Listing any makes it loop over them (needs `context_window` on the agent and a model that calls tools). Absent or empty: one model call, text back. edit, write and bash change files, so an agent gets them only by name.

items.description: read: read a file. glob: list files by pattern. grep: find a literal string. edit: replace one exact, unique occurrence in a file. write: create or replace a file. bash: run a shell command in a Landlock sandbox (writes only in the project and /tmp, reads limited, no network unless `network: true`). fetch: read a public web page as text.

max_steps.description: Most model calls one delegation may make. At the limit the agent gets one last call, without tools, to report what it did.

network.description: Let `bash` commands open outbound TCP connections. Off by default: a command that can read files and reach the network can send what it reads anywhere. Needs the `bash` tool; restricting it needs Linux 6.7+.

readable.description: Extra paths `bash` commands may read, besides the project, the system directories and common toolchain directories. Absolute, or starting with ~/. Needs the `bash` tool.
